exposure: Availability of Basic Emergency Obstetric and Newborn Care (BEmONC) signal functions
Availability of Comprehensive Emergency Obstetric and Newborn Care (CEmONC) signal functions
outcome: Availability of EmONC services by facility type
Availability of EmONC services by district
cohort: The study included all public and private facilities providing obstetric inpatient care in 24 districts of Bangladesh.
finding: Comprehensive EmONC services (C-section and blood transfusion) met minimum availability requirements in the public sector, but basic EmONC services, particularly assisted vaginal delivery and parental anticonvulsants, required private sector participation due to significant inter-district variations and poor availability in public district/sub-district facilities.
cross-section timing: Data was collected on performance in the last three months prior to the date of assessment.
